root_cause_verification.rationale: The root cause was that the nearest-neighbor GPS optimiser had no semantic awareness of meal time windows — constraints existed only as a soft post-hoc validation hint ('Verify meal times are reasonable'). The fix inserts the SEMANTIC TIME WINDOW CONSTRAINTS block directly into the timeline construction step (before the Schema ref fields table in timeline.md Tasks section, and immediately after the route-optimization.json order instruction in plan.md Phase 2 item 2). The validation checklist bullet at timeline.md line 154 now references the hard constraints and treats any violation as a missed clamping step requiring correction — not a soft advisory. Git diff confirms these exact additions between commit 199df19 (last timeline.md/plan.md change) and 0d4733b (current HEAD).

band_aid_detection.rationale: No threshold was lowered. The old soft hint was replaced (in the Tasks section) by a harder rule, which is the opposite of a band-aid. No try/except added. No severity downgraded. No validation removed. The change is purely additive instructions that increase constraint strictness.

build_verification.skip_reason: Change affects only agent prompt instruction files (.claude/agents/timeline.md and .claude/commands/plan.md). These are text instruction files consumed by AI agents at runtime, not deployed code. No compiled artifact, no Docker rebuild, no service restart is needed or applicable. The 'running application' for these files is the AI agent that reads them at task-start; there is no build step.
